item.title: Reinforce, Don’t Reopen: Why Digital Trade Matters in the 2026 USMCS Review
item.description: CSIS Americas Fellow Diego Marroquin Bitar analyzes the current North American digital trade framework ahead of the 2026 USMCA free trade agreement joint review.

item.title: CSIS Names Ambassador Edgard Kagan Freeman Chair in China Studies
item.description: The Center for Strategic and International Studies today announced that Ambassador (ret.) Edgard D. Kagan has joined CSIS as the Freeman Chair in China Studies.

item.title: China’s High-Tech Drive in 10 Charts
item.description: In this commentary, Scott Kennedy breaks down the main findings of his CSIS report, The Power of Innovation: The Strategic Value of China’s High-Tech Drive, through 10 charts.

item.title: Unpacking the $1.5 Trillion FY 2027 Defense Budget Topline
item.description: On April 3, the White House released details of its defense budget request for FY 2027. Seamus Daniels unpacks the $1.5 trillion topline requested for national defense and its implications for congressional action.

item.title: Can Gen Z Protests Reshape Governance in Africa?
item.description: Across Africa, Gen Z–led protests are redefining political engagement. But can this new wave of activism move beyond disruption to deliver lasting institutional change?

item.title: Can the United States Enable Post-Conflict Stability?
item.description: When the United States takes military action, how can it help countries go from that military action to prosperity, democracy, and stability?

item.title: Reining in the Export Control Arms Race
item.description: Export controls are evolving from a national security policy tool to an instrument of economic coercion. When Trump and Xi meet next in May, reining in the arms race should be at the top of the agenda.

item.title: Preparing for the Consequences of Collapse in Cuba
item.description: CSIS experts explore the ongoing humanitarian crisis in Cuba, and lay out recommendations for the United States and international community to address growing need on the island.

item.title: What Are the Unintended Consequences of the U.S.-Iran Conflict for Defense and Security?
item.description: Exploring the unintended consequences of the US-Iran conflict for global defense and security, including hybrid threats, technology, alliances, and strategy.
